sections.title: 1. Choose what to scan
sections.body: Add one or more files or folders to the scan list. You can mix files and folders in the same scan, and remove anything you added by mistake before you start.

sections.title: 2. Run the scan
sections.body: Start the scan and watch progress for each path. Scanning happens entirely on this device — nothing is uploaded. You can cancel at any point without leaving anything behind.

sections.title: 3. Review findings
sections.body: Filter by category, search by file path, and open a file to see which identifiers were found in it. Paths that could not be read are listed separately so nothing is silently skipped.

sections.title: 4. Export a report
sections.body: Export the selected findings — or all of them — as a JSON report you can share with your team or keep for your records. You choose where it is saved.

aboutDialog.title: Akhtabooti
aboutDialog.description: Akhtabooti scans local files and folders for personally identifiable information such as email addresses and phone numbers, so you know what personal data you are holding before you share or archive it.
aboutDialog.privacy: 🔒 All scanning happens on this device. Akhtabooti makes no network requests — no file contents and no findings ever leave this machine.
